name: bng-metric-digital-prototype
description: bng-metric-digital-prototype. GOV.UK Prototype Kit with CDP Platform running capabilities
author: Defra DDTS

scripts.dev: node -e "process.env.PORT='3010'; const child = require('node:child_process').spawn('govuk-prototype-kit', ['dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); child.on('exit', code => process.exit(code));"
scripts.lib:status: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='node_modules/bng-library';try{const s=fs.lstatSync(p);console.log('bng-library: '+(s.isSymbolicLink()?('LINKED -> '+fs.realpathSync(p)):'installed from pin (not linked)'))}catch{console.log('bng-library: not installed')}"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:features
